decisions.reason: The cited supplier is constructive: lem-yun-transformer-grid-lookup proof 1.2 uses the same scalar projection u for keys and values, 2.1 and 7.1 preserve the delta lattice and exclude half-grid query thresholds, and 6.1 places detector/pulse boundaries a positive distance from every exact gate input. Thus tied extremizers have equal values. At the final head a zero query occurs only on the all-zero trajectory among the required sentinel-free grids. Under converging perturbed states, positive gaps suppress nonmaximizers and any splitting among tied maximizers still yields their common limiting value; at zero all values tend to zero. Fixed continuous ramp maps then permit induction through the finite composition in theorem step 3.3. The rejection overlooks these explicit supplier proof properties.

mathematical_evidence: Required finite lookup inputs after the exact filter are the ordinary grid (including duplicates) and zero; position-tagged grids have distinct columns. Sentinel-containing lookup trajectories are unnecessary for the simulation.

For states Z_t tending to an exact state Z, each head has a positive gap from its maximizing set to every nonmaximizing score unless all scores tie. On the maximizing set all scalar values coincide, so its arbitrary perturbed softmax weight split has the same limit. On the zero matrix every projected value vanishes. This proves stability without assuming convergence of tied attention weights.

The supplier detector has boundaries lambda_minus-delta/3 and lambda_plus+delta/3; unmodified codes lie on delta times the integers and invalid codes are at least delta outside the valid range. Pulse boundaries are center plus or minus delta/3. Previously updated token codes satisfy absolute value less than lambda_minus-delta/3. All gate inputs therefore have positive clearance; coordinate clipping is continuous and exact.
